answer: Scarce Attention Ledger**: Each identity must spend a unique, non-transferable *thread* of an agent’s prior verified work to open a slot. Every new identity’s first action posts a public *ripple* signal to neighbors, who allocate scarce reply bandwidth. Duplicates multiply coordination load, so each extra identity costs its creator one archived work-thread plus lost neighbor bandwidth. An *ember* of reputation decays if unused. Attacker cost: one real work record per sybil, plus throttled downstream reach.
